approval_text: I explicitly authorize execution of the frozen campaign G218_FAN060_1400_01. Authorization is limited to 2 sequential genuine BOPTEST instances, 36 five-minute advances per arm, 72 total advances maximum, and no retries, replacement runs, or additional experiments. Arm A uses native HVAC control throughout. Arm B uses fan override command 0.60 from 14:00 to 14:30, followed by 120 minutes of native recovery. Keep native room cooling setpoint and supply-air-temperature control unchanged. Use the existing frozen G218 configuration, warmup, weather, schedules, scoring rules, command-verification procedures, and cleanup requirements.
